gen-gf-gugi-gf-fauna-one: Bold Gugi draws its curves and stems at a single line width. Fauna One, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, varies its strokes more, so a slightly larger size gives it room.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noticia-text: Lowercase letters that nearly reach the capitals give Gugi its blunt, uniform look. Noticia Text, with a big entrance into each curve, reads in a literary, dignified way down the page.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-pridi: Distinctive Gugi stands tall, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals, every character as plain as hand-drawn marker lettering. Pridi's refined, generous curves soften Gugi's bluntness into something more classic.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-slabo-13px: Blueprint lettering, tall and blunt: Gugi keeps its line constant through every curve and stem. And Slabo 13px, a serif with large open counters, gives longer reading a bookish, dignified feel.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-glegoo: Glegoo brings big counters and a tall lowercase, while Love Ya Like A Sister keeps a level, technical-pen steadiness up top. Paragraphs in this text serif read in a refined, editorial way.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-hanuman: Hanuman, with its high-waisted lowercase, sits under the rounded, cord-like strokes of Love Ya Like A Sister. And a slightly larger size would help its wide-set s terminals show.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-kadwa: Expressive Love Ya Like A Sister holds a level, wire-like line with ascenders that barely rise above the lowercase. And Kadwa, a serif with open-ended curves and a large x-height, supplies all the openness here.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-noticia-: Technical-pen steadiness: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps a level beat, its terminals pointing outward. And Noticia Text, with big entrances into its curves, adds a literary, dignified depth.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-slabo-13: Bookish and dignified, Slabo 13px has large open counters against the bent pipe-cleaner texture of Love Ya Like A Sister. Extended paragraphs of this serif keep each rounded letter plainly legible.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-fauna-one: Generous sidebearings and a high-set midline give Metamorphous its commanding, soft-contrasted look. Fauna One brings a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, a literary, dignified partner for the display letters.
